defects.title: Missing participant authorization on message reactions endpoint
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Obtain token for outsider user not in conversation.
2. POST to /api/chat/conversations/{cid}/messages/{mid}/reactions with emoji.
defects.expectedBehavior: API must return 403 Forbidden when user is not a member/participant in the target conversation.
defects.actualBehavior: API returned 200 OK and attached outsider reaction without verifying conversation membership.

defects.title: Firestore security rules allow message injection by non-participants
defects.stepsToReproduce:
1. Authenticate as User C using client SDK.
2. Attempt setDoc into /conversations/{directConvId}/messages/{mid} with senderId=UserC.uid.
defects.expectedBehavior: Rules must require isConversationParticipant(get(/databases/$(database)/documents/conversations/$(cid)).data) on message create.
defects.actualBehavior: Rules only verified request.resource.data.senderId == request.auth.uid, allowing non-participants to create messages directly via client SDK.
defects.evidenceSnippet: Write operation succeeded without permission-denied error

attempts.errorMessage: VULNERABILITY: Firestore rules allow outsider User C to directly insert messages into conversations they do not belong to
